chunks: So when the magicians arrived, Moses said to them: 'Cast whatever you have to cast.'
ai.seo_question: What did Moses say to the magicians when they arrived?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Yunus, Prophet Moses (peace be upon him) confidently invites Pharaoh's magicians to cast their spells first, demonstrating his readiness to face their illusion with divine truth. This moment highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the superiority of Haqq (truth) over Batil (falsehood), as Moses' calm demeanor contrasts with the magicians' reliance on worldly power. The challenge sets the stage for the miraculous demonstration that will ultimately convince the magicians of Moses' divine mission.
